24-hour operation followed and became a competitive urban promise.
2019 franchisee/headquarters conflict over 24-hour opening was national news.
JFTC indicated forcing 24-hour operation could raise competition-law concerns in some conditions.
Seven-Eleven Japan 2026 comments: on the order of about 1,400 domestic stores (~6%) with changed hours, including overnight closures.
